verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own docs say the product is offered as a managed API, in-VPC, or self-hosted, so self-hosting is a first-party option. That support rests on one line in the llms.txt summary, with no deployment guide, requirements or hands-on report to show how complete it is. Missing for 10: self-hosted deployment documentation (container/Kubernetes setup, hardware/GPU requirements, licensing or access terms), confirmation of which models and features are available on-prem, and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted use.
